name: SortField
description: The SortField object contains all the sort information for the Worksheet, ListObject, and AutoFilter objects.
remarks: Developers can use the BeforeSort event to override Excel's default behavior and put their own sort algorithm into the application.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: SortOn
properties.description: Returns or sets the attribute of the cell to sort on. Read/write XlSortOn.

properties.name: SortOnValue
properties.description: Returns the value on which the sort is performed for the specified SortField object. Read-only.

properties.name: Key
properties.description: Specifies the range that is currently being sorted on. Read-only.

properties.name: Order
properties.description: Determines the sort order for the values specified in the key. Read/write.

properties.name: CustomOrder
properties.description: Specifies a custom order to sort the fields. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: DataOption
properties.description: Specifies how to sort text in the range specified in a SortField object. Read/write XlSortDataOption.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Specifies the priority for the sort field. Read/write.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes the specified SortField object from the SortFields collection.

methods.name: ModifyKey
methods.description: Modify the key value by which values are sorted in the field.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Specifies the key to be modified.

methods.name: SetIcon
methods.description: Sets an icon for a SortField object.
